CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS job_hunter_eod_log (
  id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  s_no TEXT UNIQUE,
  resume_id TEXT,
  company_name TEXT,
  position_title TEXT,
  portal_name TEXT,
  apply_channel TEXT DEFAULT 'IN_PORTAL',
  apply_status TEXT DEFAULT 'Applied',
  behavioral_qa_json JSONB DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
  jd_url TEXT,
  applied_date DATE DEFAULT CURRENT_DATE,
  eod_reported BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS job_hunter_telegram_notifications (
  notif_key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  s_no TEXT,
  resume_id TEXT,
  notif_type TEXT,
  sent_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS job_hunter_followup_drafts (
  draft_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  s_no TEXT,
  resume_id TEXT,
  company_name TEXT,
  position_title TEXT,
  recipient_name TEXT,
  recipient_role TEXT,
  from_email TEXT DEFAULT 'user@example.com',
  subject TEXT,
  body_text TEXT,
  status TEXT DEFAULT 'Pending Approval',
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
  last_reminded_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS job_hunter_bot_state (
  chat_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  pending_action TEXT,
  target_id TEXT,
  scope TEXT,
  extra_json JSONB DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

SELECT
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(notif_key), '[]'::json) FROM job_hunter_telegram_notifications) AS sent_notifs,
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(e)), '[]'::json) FROM job_hunter_eod_log e) AS eod_logs,
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(d)), '[]'::json) FROM job_hunter_followup_drafts d) AS followup_drafts,
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(v)), '[]'::json) FROM portal_credentials_vault v) AS vault_rows;

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO job_hunter_telegram_notifications (notif_key, s_no, resume_id, notif_type)
SELECT
  x->>'notif_key',
  x->>'s_no',
  x->>'resume_id',
  x->>'notif_type'
FROM jsonb_array_elements($1::jsonb) AS x
ON CONFLICT (notif_key) DO NOTHING;
